schema.description: One delivery offer. capacityBand (ADR 0023) is optional: it is omitted when the book of the offer's window has no finite capacity, and on an offer read back with GET /delivery-quotes/{quoteId}, because the band is a quote-time reading that is not stored. It changes no offer, window or order. consolidationEligible (ADR 0024) is present only for the tier CONSOLIDATED.

tier.description: Service tier (promise.Tier). CONSOLIDATED is the opt-in tier of a customer-chosen delivery day (ADR 0024): a quote returns it only when its request lists it or names consolidatedDeliveryDay, so a caller that never asks never sees it.
tier.title: Tier

items.description: A line of a delivery offer or a promise, with the owner whose stock at the witness node covers it (ADR 0017). One owner covers the whole line; the units of several owners never add up.

ownerRef.description: The seller (sellerId) whose listing covers the line, chosen by the OwnerChoice rule. Optional and additive; omitted when the line is operator-owned.

items.title: PromisedLine

window.description: The delivery window as two instants (RFC 3339 UTC) and the local calendar they belong to. A delivery date is a day of the destination's calendar: convert earliest and latest into timeZone before taking their date (e.g. 2026-10-31T14:00:00Z..2026-11-01T02:00:00Z in America/Chicago is the single day 2026-10-31).

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the delivery station serving the destination. Always set on a new offer; omitted only for an offer stored before it was carried (ADR 0011), in which case read the window in UTC.

window.title: DeliveryWindow

witnessPath.description: The node, pickup departure, departure legs and delivery wave that prove feasibility. A NOMINAL path (STANDARD and CONSOLIDATED only) carries no departure or wave ids: pickupDepartureId and deliveryWaveId are omitted and legs is empty (E8). A carrier path of a CARRIER_HANDOFF area names carrierId and handoffNodeId instead of deliveryWaveId (ADR 0026).

carrierId.description: The carrier that delivers a CARRIER_HANDOFF area, named instead of a delivery wave (ADR 0026); omitted when the path ends on a wave.

handoffNodeId.description: The node the carrier collects at (ADR 0026); omitted when the path ends on a wave.

witnessPath.title: WitnessPath

expiresAt.description: min(quotedAt + offerTtl, the latest instant the witness pickup cutoff can still be met).

orderByAt.description: The latest instant the order can be placed and still make the quoted window's witness pickup cutoff (cutoff minus the effective handling, in business time). Unlike expiresAt it is not capped by the offer TTL; ordering before it keeps the quoted window even after a re-quote. Snapshots quoted before the field existed expose the zero time.

groupNo.description: Quote-relative shipment group number (1 for a single-node cart).

basis.description: Promise basis: SCHEDULED from the timetable, MEASURED when a leg's measured transit pushed the arrival later (ADR 0014), NOMINAL from lane times (STANDARD and CONSOLIDATED only).
basis.title: Basis

confidence.description: The calibrated probability, rounded to three decimals, that a quote is kept on time (ADR 0020): the share of the judged promises of its segment (tier, basis, node grade) whose lateness was within the buffer the quote carries. It is present only when the segment has at least minCalibrationObservations judgements in the window; absent means UNKNOWN, never zero, and consumers must read absence that way.
confidence.title: Confidence

policyVersion.description: The promise policy version the quote used (G8).

capacityBand.description: The capacity pressure on the PromiseBook that the offer's chosen window would charge, read when the offer was quoted (ADR 0023): utilisation u = (provisional + confirmed holds) / capacity share. AMPLE: u < 0.60. TIGHT: 0.60 <= u < 0.85. SCARCE: u >= 0.85. The thresholds are constants of the service, not policy fields. A signal only: the network never computes a fee, and it reserves nothing (only POST /promises holds capacity).
capacityBand.title: CapacityBand

consolidationEligible.description: Present only for the tier CONSOLIDATED (ADR 0024): true when the chosen delivery day leaves the network at least one local day after the fastest feasible window to merge the order with others, false when the day is that window itself. It is computed from this service's own candidate set and never asserts that another order exists. Omitted for every other tier, and never false by default.
consolidationEligible.title: ConsolidationEligible

carrierArea.description: True when the offer's final leg is the chosen carrier of a CARRIER_HANDOFF area instead of a delivery wave (ADR 0026); omitted otherwise.

schema.title: DeliveryOffer

404.description: Not found (not-found): the offer or promise does not exist; an identifier carrying a NUL character is resource-not-found.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).

500.description: Unexpected failure (internal-error); the detail never leaks the internal message. A 5xx is never stored for an Idempotency-Key, so the same key can retry.

detail.example: Book AUS3:dep-pickup-0418 has no room left (share 2500).
